name: Ground Wood

weightBudget.basis: One 35 mm sandstone pavement tile, rounded cobbles and shallow joints; 1024/512 colour atlases, lower resolution normal/ORM and Meshopt geometry.

reviewNotes: PDF page 3. Full wooden floor with four frame rails and inner planks, native 35 mm base, 10 mm mounting depth, maximum 19.5249 mm. Measured sculpt normal variances: interior nx²=0.343,ny²=0.095; north/south nx²=0.097,ny²=0.321; east/west nx²=0.302,ny²=0.131. Grain follows Y inside and along east/west rails, X along north/south rails; separate end grain, warm wood palette, roughness and recessed dirt.
